function.name: cosmos_infer
function.description: Analyze casualty images or videos with the Cosmos VLM. Use this when the task requires visual inspection of media.

videos.description: List of real canonical video paths.

images.description: List of real canonical image paths.

reasoning.description: Whether to request reasoning_content from Cosmos.

fps.description: Frames per second to sample for video inference.

function.name: medical_static_assessment
function.description: Run a structured static-image medical triage assessment and return 0/1 labels for the static subset of the label space.

sensor_name.description: Sensor type: 'rgb' for day or 'ir' for infrared/night.

images.description: List of image paths to assess.

function.name: medical_temporal_assessment
function.description: Run a structured video-based medical triage assessment and return 0/1 labels for the temporal subset of the label space.

sensor_name.description: Sensor type: 'rgb' for day/electro-optical or 'ir' for infrared/night.

videos.description: List of video paths to assess.

reasoning.description: Whether to request reasoning output from Cosmos.

fps.description: Video sampling FPS to use for temporal assessment.
